camel_example: aliyun ddoscoo ModifyInstance --region cn-hangzhou --ModifyType Upgrade --InstanceId 'ddoscoo-cn-6ja1y6p50000' --ProductType ddoscoo
description_en: Modifies the specifications of an Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance
kebab_example: aliyun ddoscoo modify-instance --instance-id ddoscoo-cn-6ja1y6p50000 --modify-type Upgrade --product-type ddoscoo --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyInstance

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance.
You can invoke https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157459.html to query the IDs of all Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instances
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS高防实例的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157459.html查询所有DDoS高防实例的ID信息
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of specification change. Valid values:
UPGRADE: Upgrade.
DOWNGRADE: Downgrade
parameters.help_zh:
变配类型，取值
UPGRADE：升级。
DOWNGRADE：降级
parameters.name: modify_type

parameters.help_en: The clean bandwidth (outside the Chinese mainland). Unit: Mbit/s
parameters.help_zh: 业务带宽（非中国内地）。单位：Mbps
parameters.name: normal_bandwidth

parameters.help_en: The clean bandwidth (the Chinese mainland). Unit: Mbit/s
parameters.help_zh: 业务带宽（中国内地）。单位：Mbps
parameters.name: service_bandwidth

parameters.help_en: The basic protection bandwidth (the Chinese mainland). Unit: Gbit/s
parameters.help_zh: 保底防护带宽（中国内地）。单位：Gbps
parameters.name: base_bandwidth

parameters.help_en: The burstable protection bandwidth (the Chinese mainland). Unit: Gbit/s
parameters.help_zh: 弹性防护带宽（中国内地）。单位：Gbps
parameters.name: bandwidth

parameters.help_en: The number of protected domain names
parameters.name: domain_count

parameters.help_en: The clean queries per second (QPS). Unit: Mbit/s
parameters.name: normal_qps

parameters.help_en:
The product type.

Valid values:

ddoscoo: indicates that the China site account is used for specification changes of an Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium (Chinese mainland) instance.
ddoscoo_intl: indicates that the international site account is used for specification changes of an Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium (Chinese mainland) instance.
ddosDip: indicates that the China site account or international site account is used for specification changes of an Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium (outside the Chinese mainland) instance
parameters.help_zh:
产品类型。
取值：

ddoscoo：表示中国站账号为DDoS高防（中国内地）实例变配。
ddoscoo_intl：表示国际站账号为DDoS高防（中国内地）实例变配。
ddosDip：表示中国站账号或国际站账号为DDoS高防（非中国内地）实例变配
parameters.name: product_type

parameters.help_en:
The address type. Valid values:
Ipv4: IPv4.
Ipv6: IPv6
parameters.help_zh:
地址类型。取值：
Ipv4：IPv4。
Ipv6：IPv6
parameters.name: address_type

parameters.help_en:
The mitigation plan (outside the Chinese mainland). Valid values:

0: Insurance mitigation plan for Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium (outside the Chinese mainland).
1: Unlimited mitigation plan for Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium (outside the Chinese mainland).
2: acceleration line for Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium (outside the Chinese mainland).
3: secure acceleration line for Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium (outside the Chinese mainland)
parameters.help_zh:
防护套餐（非中国内地）。取值：

0：表示DDoS高防（非中国内地）保险版。
1：表示DDoS高防（非中国内地）无忧版。
2：表示DDoS高防（非中国内地）加速线路。
3：表示DDoS高防（非中国内地）安全加速线路
parameters.name: product_plan

parameters.help_en:
The mitigation plan (the Chinese mainland). Valid values:

coop: Professional Edition of Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium (Chinese mainland).
advance: Professional Edition of Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium (Chinese mainland)
parameters.help_zh:
防护套餐（中国内地）。取值：

coop：表示DDoS高防（中国内地）专业版。
advance：表示DDoS高防（中国内地）专业版
parameters.name: edition_sale

parameters.help_en:
The line resource of the instance (the Chinese mainland). Valid values:

coop-line-001: eight-line BGP line for Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium (Chinese mainland)
parameters.help_zh:
实例的线路资源（中国内地）。取值：

coop-line-001：表示DDoS高防（中国内地）八线BGP线路
parameters.name: service_partner

parameters.help_en:
The function version. Valid values:

0: standard features.
1: enhanced features
parameters.help_zh:
功能版本，取值：

0：标准功能。
1：增强功能
parameters.name: function_version
